title: Atlanta Fiber System Experiment: Optical Crosstalk Evaluation for Two End-to-End Lightguide System Installations
version: The Bell System Technical Journal 57(6), part 1, July–August 1978, pp. 1759–1769.
lineage: Original Bell System engineering publication, accessed as a World Radio History facsimile of the printed issue. The local reading notes identify the inspected scan by SHA-256.

passages.note: The authors measured the installed Franklin–Wabash and Franklin–Brunswick links from optical distributing frames. They give the change from twelve to two twelve-fiber ribbons, the ten connectorized segments and array splices. The paper shares Buckler with the cable manufacture report but presents measurements on the receiving installation.
